title: 第14章尘封已久的记忆
slug: 斗罗开局被逼入赘对象宁荣荣
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“有心了。”

宁风致将软甲重新放回木盒里，语气里的客气淡了几分，多了几分真切的赞许。他没直接收下，反而把木盒递了回去。

“这东西，还是你亲手交给荣荣更好一些。”

转头对门外的弟子吩咐道。

“去，把小姐请过来，就说她的未婚夫已经到了，让她来见一见。”

侍女躬身应了一声，快步退了下去。

尘心站在一旁，目光自始至终都落在江蓠身上，像是要把她从里到外看个通透。

弟子前脚刚走，就见一名侍女跌跌撞撞地跑了进来，脸色惨白得像见了鬼一样。

“宗主！不好了宗主！”侍女“噗通”一声跪倒在地，声音里带着哭腔。

“小姐她……小姐她离家出走了！”

“你说什么？”

大殿里死一般的寂静。

尘心的眉头瞬间拧成了疙瘩，握剑的手都紧了几分。

古榕端着茶杯的手顿在半空，嘴角抽了抽。

好家伙。

这小公主是真能闹啊。

宁风致深吸了一口气，脸上虽然没什么表情，但熟悉他的人都知道，这位素来温文尔雅的宗主，此刻已经动了真怒。

“跑了多久了？”

“几……几个时辰了……”

这丫头，整天就不让人省心，又闹离家出走，都第几次了。

宁风致深吸了口气，指尖按在眉心狠狠揉了两下，刚要开口下令全宗搜查，话到嘴边却忽然顿住了。

他的目光扫过一旁依旧端坐的江蓠，沉默了两秒，脸上的怒色居然像退潮似的慢慢散了，反而露出一个意味深长的笑容。

“小江啊，你看这事儿……真是不巧。本来想让你们见一面的，谁知道这丫头这么任性。”

“如今宗门人手不足，你看……能不能麻烦你下山一趟，帮我把荣荣找回来？”

“范围？”

江蓠抬眸看了他一眼，淡金色的瞳孔里没什么情绪，只是静静地等着他的下文。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"I'm determined."

Ning Fengzhi put the soft armor back into the wooden box, and the politeness in his tone became a little less polite and a little more genuine praise.He didn't accept it directly, but handed the wooden box back.

"It would be better if you hand this thing over to Rongrong yourself."

He turned around and gave instructions to the disciples outside the door.

"Go, invite the lady over, tell her that her fiancé has arrived, and ask her to come and meet him."

The maid bowed in response and quickly retreated.

Chen Xin stood aside, his eyes falling on Jiang Li from beginning to end, as if he wanted to see her from the inside out.

As soon as the disciple left, he saw a maid staggering in, her face as pale as if she had seen a ghost.

"Sect Master! It's not good, Sect Master!" The maid fell to her knees with a "pop" sound, her voice filled with tears.

"Miss, she...Miss, she ran away from home!"

"What did you say?"

There was deathly silence in the hall.

Chen Xin's brows instantly turned into knots, and the hand holding the sword tightened a little.

Gu Rong's hand holding the tea cup paused in mid-air, and the corners of her mouth twitched.

Good guy.

This little princess is really capable of making trouble.

Ning Fengzhi took a deep breath. Although there was no expression on his face, people who knew him well knew that this usually gentle and gentle sect master was really angry at this moment.

"How long have you been running?"

"How many...how many hours..."

This girl has been worrying all day long and has run away from home for the first time.

Ning Fengzhi took a deep breath, put his fingertips on the center of his eyebrows and rubbed them twice. He was about to open his mouth to order the entire sect to be searched, but suddenly paused as he spoke.

His eyes swept over Gracilaria, who was still sitting upright beside him. After two seconds of silence, the anger on his face slowly dissipated like an ebbing tide, and instead he revealed a meaningful smile.

"Xiao Jiang, look at this... it's really unfortunate. I originally wanted you to meet her, but who knew this girl would be so willful."

"Now that the sect is short of manpower, look... could you please go down the mountain and help me find Rongrong?"

"Scope?"

Jiang Li raised her eyes and glanced at him. There was no emotion in her pale golden pupils, just waiting for his words quietly.
